intuition: All range-wide operations form one affine transform modulo the prime, so old values can be normalized against it.

brute_force.approach: Apply every add and multiply operation to every stored element.
brute_force.time: append O(1), addAll/multAll O(n), getIndex O(1)

optimal.approach: Store values in the inverse of the current multiplier and keep lazy multiplier/addition terms; reset the active epoch on multiplication by zero.
optimal.time: append O(log MOD), addAll O(1), multAll O(1), getIndex O(1)

edge_cases: Multiplication by zero resets every earlier element to the current affine offset.
Indices beyond the sequence length return -1.
